notes.title: [1.0.4] Patch Notes - QOL + bug squashing
notes.content: [p]Greetings gamers![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.4 of Tall Trails![/p][list][*][p]Added a toggle for "Camera Follow" to the settings menu. Turning it off should help the folks that get nausea from the camera automatically turning towards Alp[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could get caught in a loop if you fell off a structure in the final level without any stamina left[/p][/*][*][p]Bunny Badge is now \[-20%, -26%, -32%, -40%] stamina cost reduction, previously was \[-25%, -35%, -40%, -50%]*[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed visual issue with the Sorcerer's Tower windows looking bad when seen from under water[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where you could get trapped inside "Stilt Village" proc-gen structure[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p][p][/p][p]* (Re: Bunny Badge: much as I hate to balance things in this game, it was possible to climb-jump for free with just Bunny+3 and a Mirror+3, pretty OP compared to other badges.)[/p]

tags.feature: Added a toggle for "Camera Follow" to the settings menu. Turning it off should help the folks that get nausea from the camera automatically turning towards Alp

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where you could get caught in a loop if you fell off a structure in the final level without any stamina left

tags.balance_change: Bunny Badge is now \[-20%, -26%, -32%, -40%] stamina cost reduction, previously was \[-25%, -35%, -40%, -50%]

tags.bug: Fixed visual issue with the Sorcerer's Tower windows looking bad when seen from under water
Fixed an issue where you could get trapped inside "Stilt Village" proc-gen structure

notes.title: [1.0.3] Patch Notes - Bug Fixes & Small Fun Things!
notes.content: [p]Hello all![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.3 of Tall Trails![/p][p]This patch addresses a few bugs, plus makes some fun little changes that I had wanted to make pre-launch that I didn't have a chance to fit in! Hope you enjoy![/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Boot Badge didn't work past 10 items[/p][/*][*][p]Made a change to how birds work ,')[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Giant Hands" trapping players inside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the "Bug Report View" not being navigable on Steam Deck[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the main menu sometimes wouldn't reopen after you submitted a bug report[/p][/*][*][p]Brought something back[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some more typos[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p]

tags.bug: [p]Fixed an issue where Boot Badge didn't work past 10 items[/p]
[p]Fixed the "Bug Report View" not being navigable on Steam Deck[/p]
[p]Fixed a bug where the main menu sometimes wouldn't reopen after you submitted a bug report[/p]

notes.title: [1.0.1] A small patch!
notes.content: [p]Hello folks![/p][p]I just pushed up version 1.0.1 of Tall Trails! It's mostly addressing bugs you guys have found over the last few days. [/p][p]Changelog:[/p][list][*][p]Added a lil ~randomization~ to something that happens at the end of the game when playing in New Game+ or Randomizer mode[/p][/*][*][p]Made the trigger for winning the Blimp Race bigger & taller, so it will be a little easier to hit when approaching it at near lightspeed[/p][/*][*][p]Added some playtesters to the credits whose names accidentally dropped off the list. Sorry about that![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "T-Rex Fossil" & "Desk Lamp" statues trapping players inside[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where returning clay to Cupp from a world other than the one you're currently in would not be saved properly[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where if you summitted, but didn't collect the clay, the clay wouldn't respawn when loading the island again[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain proc-gen islands would fail to load properly[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some typos[/p][/*][/list][p]Thanks to everyone who submitted bug reports![/p][p]Brady[/p]

tags.feature: [p]Added a lil ~randomization~ to something that happens at the end of the game when playing in New Game+ or Randomizer mode[/p]

tags.balance_change: [p]Made the trigger for winning the Blimp Race bigger & taller, so it will be a little easier to hit when approaching it at near lightspeed[/p]

tags.feature: [p]Added some playtesters to the credits whose names accidentally dropped off the list. Sorry about that![/p]

tags.bug: [p]Fixed "T-Rex Fossil" & "Desk Lamp" statues trapping players inside[/p]
[p]Fixed a bug where returning clay to Cupp from a world other than the one you're currently in would not be saved properly[/p]
[p]Fixed an issue where if you summitted, but didn't collect the clay, the clay wouldn't respawn when loading the island again[/p]
[p]Fixed a bug where certain proc-gen islands would fail to load properly[/p]

notes.title: [v.0.8.1] Fixing Demo Bugs!
notes.content:
Hi folks,

Huge thanks to everyone who's played the demo so far, the response has been wonderful!

I'm uploading a new build to fix some user reported bugs.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that would cause the game to break when running on a computer with Spanish set as the primary language
[*] Fixed a bug that caused erasing your saves in slot #2 or slot #3 to also erase your world data in slot #1
[/list]
Thanks to everyone who reported bugs! If you find a bug, you can report it via the "Pause" menu while using mouse & keyboard.

- Brady

tags.bug: [*] Fixed a bug that would cause the game to break when running on a computer with Spanish set as the primary language
[*] Fixed a bug that caused erasing your saves in slot #2 or slot #3 to also erase your world data in slot #1
